steps.name: Original Ansible tasks
steps.shell:
- name: "19.7.8.3 | PATCH | Ensure Do not use diagnostic data for tailored experiences is set to Enabled"
  when: win25cis_rule_19_7_8_3
  tags:
    - level2-domaincontroller
    - level2-memberserver
    - automated
    - rule_19.7.8.3
    - patch
    - cloudcontent
    - NIST800-171_3.4.6
    - NIST800-171_3.4.7
    - NIST800-53R5_SI-4
  ansible.windows.win_regedit:
    path: HKU:\{{ item }}\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\CloudContent
    name: DisableTailoredExperiencesWithDiagnosticData
    data: 1
    type: dword
  loop: "{{ discovered_hku_loaded_list }}"
  notify: Change_Requires_Reboot
